name: Ryuumyaku no Another Eidos R
original_name: 龍脈のアナザーエイドスR
source:
The story revolves around a nameless warrior's misadventures in spite of their intention to defeat the Dragon King, instead inheriting his divine power. 

Summary from AnotherEidos wiki [https://anothereidoswiki.ddns.net/index.php/Main_Page]
translation:
故事围绕一位无名战士的不幸遭遇展开，尽管他们本想打败龙王，但却继承了他的神力。

来自AnotherEidos wiki的摘要 [https://anothereidoswiki.ddns.net/index.php/Main_Page]
